
server {
    listen 80;
    server_name wiki.openipc.org;
    #
    access_log /var/log/nginx/org.openipc.wiki.access.log;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/org.openipc.wiki.error.log info;
    #
    # Stays ahead of everything below: dehydrated renews this certificate over
    # HTTP-01 on port 80, and `^~` beats the regex locations as well as the
    # prefix one. A redirect here would fail every renewal.
    location ^~ /.well-known/acme-challenge {
        proxy_redirect off;
        default_type "text/plain";
        alias   /var/lib/dehydrated/acme-challenges;
        allow all;
    }
    location / {
        return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
    }
}


server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name wiki.openipc.org;
    #
    # Its own log. This block wrote into org.openipc.access.log until 2026-08-24,
    # so every HTTPS request to the wiki was filed under the main site and the
    # only wiki traffic anyone could see was the port-80 redirects.
    access_log /var/log/nginx/org.openipc.wiki.access.log;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/org.openipc.wiki.error.log info;
    #
    ssl_certificate /var/lib/dehydrated/certs/wiki.openipc.org/fullchain.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /var/lib/dehydrated/certs/wiki.openipc.org/privkey.pem;
    #
    ssl_protocols TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3;
    ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
    ssl_dhparam /etc/ssl/certs/dhparam.pem;
    ssl_ciphers ECDHE-ECDSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:ECDHE-ECDSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384:ECDHE-ECDSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:ECDHE-RSA-CHACHA20-POLY1305:DHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256:DHE-RSA-AES256-GCM-SHA384;
    ssl_session_timeout 1d;
    ssl_session_cache shared:SSL:10m;
    ssl_stapling off;
    ssl_stapling_verify on;
    ssl_session_tickets off;
    add_header Strict-Transport-Security max-age=15768000;
    #
    # No `resolver` any more: it was here for proxy_pass, and nothing is
    # proxied from this server block now.

    # A page that was named keeps being named. The wiki moved to a repository
    # whose paths are the ones this host already used -- en/ and ru/ at the top,
    # the same filenames -- so the old URL can be carried across instead of
    # dropping every visitor on an index and asking them to search again.
    location ~ ^/(en|ru)/(.+)\.html$ {
        return 301 https://github.com/OpenIPC/wiki/blob/master/$1/$2.md;
    }

    # Some links were published against the source filename rather than the
    # rendered one.
    location ~ ^/(en|ru)/(.+)\.md$ {
        return 301 https://github.com/OpenIPC/wiki/blob/master/$1/$2.md;
    }

    # Everything else -- the root, a directory, an image, a path from a wiki
    # layout that no longer exists.
    location / {
        return 301 https://github.com/OpenIPC/wiki;
    }
}
